en.quote: The armaments programme, among others, approved 2,300 units by 2020.
en.head: Series deliveries of the Armata tank slipped to 2021.
en.body: In 2015 the head of Uralvagonzavod spoke of 2,300 vehicles on the Armata platform by 2020, while acknowledging in the same interview that deliveries might slip toward 2025. In 2020, Rostec said series deliveries of the T-14 tank would begin only in 2021. This points to a missed original deadline; the source does not establish the exact number built on the entire platform.

osrc.t: Rostec, on series deliveries starting in 2021
